answer_2.quote: Table reports the performance of NLU models measured with standard evaluation metrics before and after back transcription (BT) is applied to the MASSIVE dataset.

answer_4.quote: The backtranscribed prompts were presented to the annotator along with the original prompts and the recording of the TTS output. The goal of the annotator was to choose which of the two transcripts was closer to the content of the recording.
answer_4.guideline: The goal of the annotator was to choose which of the two transcripts was closer to the content of the recording. If both options were equally viable, the annotator was allowed to choose both as the answer.
